scope: TI TPS259474 current-limit accuracy source audit; review only

published_claim.claim: Adjustable threshold 0.5A to 6A; ±10% accuracy for ILIM > 1A
published_claim.applies_to_design_candidate: TPS259474LRPW and tape-and-reel ordering variant TPS259474LRPWR share the same RPW package and silicon family variant; ordering suffix only differs

datasheet_electrical_characteristics.test_condition: -40C <= TJ <= 125C; VIN=12V; stated table default conditions

finding: The 3.32kΩ electrical-characteristics row does not agree with applying the product-page ±10% claim to the 3334/R equation. The source does not provide a guaranteed min/max row at the design's 2.21kΩ value. Do not infer a guaranteed minimum for 2.21kΩ by interpolation, extrapolation, or taking the product-page headline at face value.
required_resolution: Obtain written TI clarification for TPS259474LRPW current-limit accuracy and the 2.21kΩ setpoint over the specified operating range, or select a resistor/setpoint with an applicable guaranteed electrical-characteristics limit.
Re-evaluate the motor, branch, connector, wiring and thermal protection envelope before changing R_ILM.
Keep the unverified measured-evidence field efuse_min_current_limit_a null until supported by an attributable manufacturer specification and the applicable configuration is fixed.
Perform instrumented no-load and fault-injection HIL after the circuit, motor SKU and current profile are resolved.
